en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large historic town hall on a cobbled square. The building has several stories, a steep tiled roof, and a tall central clock tower with an ornate baroque spire and weather vane. Two large clock faces are visible on the tower. The façade includes many rectangular windows, decorative gables, and an elaborate main portal at ground level. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk across the open square; small carts stand at the left edge. The sky is blank and white, emphasizing the architecture.
